note: Copy to configs/camera.json and fill from calibration (Hardware). T_base_cam: camera pose in arm base_arm's base frame, 4x4, metres, OpenCV camera axes (x right, y down, z forward); or give T_table_cam directly. K: 3x3 intrinsics at image_size [w, h]. table_bounds_m: [[xmin, ymin], [xmax, ymax]] in the table frame; detections outside are dropped. This example: camera 1 m above the table centre (0.45, 0.20), looking straight down, image x along table +x.
